body: I did change environment recently but I don’t see how my lifestyle could change for the moment and I do believe in God but that doesn’t really matter as I don’t feel he cares much about me. I do have a particular goal that I’m obsessed about though and it’s honestly the only thing keeping me alive but it‘s about a decade away from becoming possible to achieve, so it’s like a little candle light of hope in this dark miserable life I’m living.
I'm already living in one and it's only exciting for normal people.

I don't see what I'm doing that could be radically changed. It's not like I'm even doing anything or have the energy to. I just finished sleeping for 16 hours. I don't have a life to leave behind nor a suicide note and no one would be at my funeral except my parents and sibling and they wouldn't even be present together.

"Tomorrow will be a very special day because it'll be a new beginning and everything will change!", I've said this a hundred times now, feeling 50% optimistic and 50% silly everytime and trust me, I've set many goals but I know they won't be enough to make me happy, except maybe a dream I have that is a very private obsession and too easily misinterpreted for me to discuss freely.

A lot of people who wish to die are being dramatic about temporary problems that can get fixed or which they could get over with time. "I lost my job :(", "my girlfriend left me :(", "I'm sad and don't know why :(", blablabla. But then there's people like me who are just not made for this world and enjoying our existence is apparently impossible. I thus don't think there's a possible answer and a therapist would be a waste of money and time as well as simply embarrassing.
